name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips or in front of your chest.
Step back with one foot and lower your back knee until it almost touches the floor. Keep your front shin almost vertical and your torso upright.
Push through the heel of your front foot to stand up and bring your back foot forward to the start position.
Repeat with the other leg, or do all the repetitions on one leg and then change legs.
